<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="utterplan-format-v5">
<h1>UtterPlan format v5</h1>
<p>Current plans are persisted as UTF-8 TOML in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.utterplan.toml</span></code> files. Their root fields identify <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">format</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">&quot;utterplan&quot;</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">schema_version</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">5</span></code>. Schema v5 is the breaking, renderer-facing contract: the executable plan is an ordered <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">flow</span></code> of render units, each containing the segments that belong to it. The canonical Python model is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code>.</p>
<p>A minimal plan looks like this:</p>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">format</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;utterplan&quot;</span>
<span class="n">schema_version</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">5</span>
<span class="n">plan_id</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;sha256:...&quot;</span>
<span class="n">language</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span>
<span class="n">unit</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;paragraph&quot;</span>
<span class="n">hash_schema</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;utterplan-flow-v1&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[document]</span>
<span class="n">format</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;plain&quot;</span>
<span class="n">semantics</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{}</span>

<span class="k">[[flow]]</span>
<span class="n">hash</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;sha256:...&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[[flow.segment]]</span>
<span class="n">text</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello world.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">token</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">span</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">12</span><span class="p">]]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<section id="compiler-only-segmentation-topology">
<h2>Compiler-only segmentation topology</h2>
<p>The compiler validates PhraseSplit proposals and owns paragraph, sentence, and sentence-part spans in spoken-text coordinates. Semicolon/context-safe colon boundaries and optional clause/parenthetical proposals may create renderer cuts; language, directive, pause, marker, and media subdivisions retain the owning sentence-part identity internally. If proposals are malformed or incomplete, deterministic fallback is used and non-whitespace text remains covered exactly.</p>
<p>Sentence parts and their indices are deliberately absent from this v5 format. The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">flow</span></code> contains only executable renderer segments and remains the compact public contract; no schema field, FlowPlan/FlowUnit/FlowSegment shape, or migration rule records private topology. Schema v5 is unchanged.</p>
</section>
<section id="executable-flow">
<h2>Executable flow</h2>
<p>Each ordered <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">flow</span></code> entry is a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowUnit</span></code> with a stable local <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">hash</span></code> and one or more <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">segment</span></code> entries. A segment contains already-prepared speech <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code>, an optional language override, local token columns, optional semantic <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_before</span></code> / <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pause_after</span></code> intents, typed renderer-neutral directives, markers, and an optional heading level. Language defaults to the root <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">language</span></code>; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unit</span></code> identifies paragraph or sentence grouping. Consumers render segments in the stored order and do not need compiler lookup tables or segment-ID joins.</p>
<p>Token <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">span</span></code> entries are half-open Python-character ranges local to their owning segment’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text</span></code>. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pos</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tag</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lemma</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">morph</span></code> columns carry token facts. Dense columns align with the spans; sparse columns are ascending <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[token_index,</span> <span class="pre">value]</span></code> pairs. Absent lemma entries derive from case-folded surface text, while an explicit empty sparse lemma preserves an unknown value. Tokens and their semantics are never indexed by plan-global token IDs.</p>
<p>Pause intents represent <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">none</span></code>, semantic strengths such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sentence</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parenthetical</span></code>, or an exact authored timed break. They do not contain planner-invented durations or renderer activation policies. A consumer decides how supported semantic intents map to engine behavior; exact authored times remain explicit. Directives are typed renderer-neutral semantics for voice, pronunciation, prosody, emphasis, say-as, substitution, audio references, and extension references. UtterPlan does not fetch audio or execute extensions.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">document</span></code> holds compact <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">DocumentInfo</span></code> such as source format, SSMD version, title, and portable document semantics. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">linguistics</span></code> optionally lists provider/model provenance. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">producer</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">warnings</span></code> are informational. The executable plan does not retain the original source document, compiler text-preparation objects, parser/provider documents, arbitrary global token tables, or diagnostic lookup graphs.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan_id</span></code> identifies canonical executable semantics, not TOML bytes. Flow-unit hashes use the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan-flow-v1</span></code> contract and are computed from each unit’s local segments. Producer identity and formatting do not alter executable identity. Plans contain no phonemes, model token IDs, models, sessions, renderer configuration, or audio.</p>
</section>
<section id="toml-api-and-optional-compiler-trace">
<h2>TOML API and optional compiler trace</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.to_toml()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.from_toml()</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.save()</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan.load()</span></code> are the persistence APIs. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">save()</span></code> writes atomically. Normal plan loading and the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">validate</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">inspect</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">explain</span></code> commands accept TOML; JSON is never auto-detected as a current plan format. Import a historical JSON plan explicitly with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">migrate</span> <span class="pre">old.utterplan.json</span> <span class="pre">-o</span> <span class="pre">current.utterplan.toml</span></code>.</p>
<p>Compiler provenance is optional and separate from executable flow. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">compile</span> <span class="pre">--trace</span> <span class="pre">plan.trace.toml</span></code> writes a versioned trace sidecar containing source text/hash, structural and prepared text, coordinate maps, preparation changes, compiler-only plan state, diagnostics, and renderability evidence. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">explain</span> <span class="pre">plan.utterplan.toml</span> <span class="pre">--trace</span> <span class="pre">plan.trace.toml</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">utterplan</span> <span class="pre">inspect-trace</span> <span class="pre">plan.trace.toml</span></code>. Trace data does not enter <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code>, plan identity, or plan TOML; compiling with and without a trace produces identical executable plans.</p>
<p>The v5 TOML codec is a deterministic human-oriented projection of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code>, not a dump of arbitrary Python object state. Direct TOML nulls, dates/times, non-finite floats, and unknown fields are rejected. Optional typed fields are omitted; free-form <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">document.semantics</span></code> preserves embedded nulls with the reserved <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">__utterplan_null__</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">true</span></code> table. The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">__utterplan_</span></code> prefix is reserved. Use the public codec rather than manually reconstructing model objects.</p>
</section>
<section id="historical-json-schemas-and-migration">
<h2>Historical JSON schemas and migration</h2>
<p>Frozen JSON Schema resources for v1, v2, v3, and v4 remain under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spec/schemas/</span></code> and their versioned package copies. They describe historical serialized semantic mappings, not current TOML syntax. Schema v5 deliberately has no JSON Schema resource or JSON plan-file format: v5 validity is defined by its <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code> model and TOML codec. Historical files and fixtures remain versioned and immutable.</p>
<p>Supported historical plans migrate sequentially through v2, v3, and v4 to v5. The v1-to-v2, v2-to-v3, v3-to-v4, and v4-to-v5 steps operate on serialized plain data only. They do not parse SSMD, invoke preparation or NLP, plan, call G2P, render, or process audio. The v4-to-v5 step projects verified segments and token spans into local flow; if token ownership/coordinates or authored pause meaning cannot be established without guessing, migration fails safely. Migration preserves a compiled plan; compiling source again is a separate operation.</p>
<p>Package version and plan schema version are independent. Historical schema files are never rewritten to match the package. Downgrades from v5 are not supported.</p>
</section>
<section id="coordinate-and-provenance-rules">
<h2>Coordinate and provenance rules</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Token <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">span</span></code> offsets address Python characters in the owning <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowSegment.text</span></code> only.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowSegment.text</span></code> is the prepared speech text for that segment.</p></li>
<li><p>Compiler trace source spans address exact input-source Python-character offsets; trace structural/spoken maps and preparation changes document their coordinate spaces explicitly.</p></li>
<li><p>The executable plan does not contain source offsets or dense text maps. Preserve a trace sidecar when source diagnostics or preparation provenance must survive a process boundary.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The codec validates token ordering and bounds, directive shape, flow hashes, plan identity, and supported schema version before returning a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FlowPlan</span></code>. Historical model decoding remains separate from the current v5 model.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
